scope: Replacement manuscript editions carry an immutable, existing-project supersedes lineage

evidence.red: rejects a replacement edition whose supersedes target is absent
evidence.green: records an immutable supersedes link when publishing a replacement edition
evidence.apiRouteCommand: npm.cmd --prefix api test -- src/app.spec.ts -t "freezes and reads a publication edition"
evidence.apiRouteResult: 1 test passed; old edition remains readable
evidence.deliveryProofResult: 25 tests passed; unlinked supersession is rejected

boundary: A replacement cannot silently overwrite or claim lineage from a missing or cross-project edition; old edition files remain independently addressable.
